notes.title: Small bugfixes
notes.content:
In the latest update, some issues have been solved:
- The language selection screen that is shown the first time the game is run, now has proper contrast and the "OK" button is easily visible
- The achievements now work as expected

Sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused! And happy new year!
